Basic image generation with a text prompt

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_image_generate_async(client, "{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":1,\"prompt\":\"A white cat sitting on a windowsill\",\"size\":\"1024x1024\"}")
IO.inspect(result)
```
